params.body:
Documentation only. The Car-Pass questions added yesterday (V-19 to V-22) were spread over three sheets and partly asked things the repository already answers. Reworked to the split below; every remaining question now names who must answer it.

## Survives, for Ilse (one question)

**V-22.** Since 2026 the used-car inspection is no longer mandatory in Flanders and the professional requests the official Car-Pass document directly: paid, observationType `CAR_PASS_DOCUMENT`, EUR 11,10 in 2026 and indexed yearly, free under four readings per vehicle, valid two months, against a balance per company, and only possible when the DIV knows the VIN. Must Stocklist be able to request that document? Today the platform only requests the free vehicle history report, the public link that must appear in every advertisement.

Noted as context, not as a question: if the answer is yes, every dealer needs their own balance at Car-Pass, so it becomes a per-dealer onboarding step, and the platform must be able to show that a balance has run out, otherwise a request fails with nobody knowing why.

## Survives, for Car-Pass support (supportIT@car-pass.be, two questions)

**V-20.** Is a `VEHICLE_HISTORY_DOCUMENT` request billed, and if so how much? The Inflow specification prices only the paid Car-Pass document and says nothing about this report, and no amount appears anywhere in our code.

**V-19.** What happens on your side when we confirm an unknown chassis number (issue 131): is the vehicle added to the Car-Pass database, or is only our odometer reading stored against that VIN? And what does the consumer see on the resulting public page?

Both numbers are unchanged, so nothing already printed goes stale.

## Removed

**V-21** ("does De Backer have a balance at Car-Pass") is gone. Once V-22 is answered yes, every dealer needs a balance of their own, so a question about one company balance decided nothing; its substance is now context under V-22 and under O-20.

**Under which account a registration leaves** is not asked at all, because the code settles it. `App\Support\CarpassHttp::credentials()` ignores `CARPASS_USERNAME` / `CARPASS_PASSWORD` on production entirely, so the dealer's own `dealers.carpass_username` / `carpass_password` always apply there and `enteredOrganisation` carries that user code; outside production the environment wins only when both keys are set, so staging never registers under production credentials riding along in a database dump, and a half-filled override is ignored.

That is already a rule, R S3-1.8 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/13-s3-car-pass.md`, and it already has `@rule`-tagged tests in `tests/Feature/CarpassEndpointTest.php` (four of them). No new rule and no new test were needed; the rule now also says that a balance therefore belongs per dealer.

## Also

- `R S3-8.7` and `O-20` point at V-22 alone instead of at V-21 and V-22, and name the consequence for the balance.
- One stale comment in `CarpassRequestFeedbackTest` said the question was "V-20/V-21"; it now says V-20, for Car-Pass support.
- `92-testdekking.md` and `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` regenerated with `bin/rules-coverage --write` and `bin/rules-page`. The coverage snapshot is unchanged (707 rules, 100 with a test, 19 percent); only the html moved.

Verified: `phpunit --filter 'Carpass|CarPass|RulesCoverage'`, 56 tests, 190 assertions, green.
params.title: Car-Pass questions: one for Ilse, two for Car-Pass
